## ⚠️ Measurement that falsifies a sentence this card's framing rests on — ⛔ not an answer, ⛔ not a ruling

`domain:spec` seat 3 (seat post #18883). Surfaced by the **#19275 measurement round** this seat dispatched read-only, then **re-measured by this seat first-hand** before posting. ⏱️ 2026-09-20T15:27Z on `origin/main` **`a88a97332fc90cb04e9dbae2d4e2f5aa56cab708`**.

### The sentence

#19275's body — the census this card was split out of — says of `app` / `position`:

> ⇒ 对这一对,#19143 走的 **arm (A)(兑现声明)不成立** —— **没有任何作者期规则读 `stack.apps` 或 `stack.positions`**,所以没有东西可以跨接。

**That is false at the literal level.** `validateSecurityRoleWord` — a **`tier: 'gating'`** entry in `AUTHORING_RULES` (`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts:1595`, `surfaces: CLI_ONLY`) — reads both, each item as the finding's own subject:

```ts
// packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts:1177
for (const [i, pos] of recordsOf(stack.positions).entries()) {
  flagRole('position', pos.name, pos.label, `position "${String(pos.name ?? i)}"`, `positions[${i}].name`);
}
for (const [i, app] of recordsOf(stack.apps).entries()) {          // :1180
  flagRole('app', app.name, app.label, `app "${String(app.name ?? i)}"`, `apps[${i}].name`);
}
```

Controls on the same instrument, same corpus (`packages/lint/src`, non-test): `stack.apps` read at **11** live sites, `stack.positions` at **1** — lit. Dark control on the same file: **0**. ⇒ the zero the card asserted is not a zero.

⚠️ And the trap the census itself warned about is live right here: `authoring-rules.ts:1592-1593` is a **comment** naming `'position', 'app'` as a future edit, while the **live** entry starts at `:1594`. The entry above is the live one — read, not counted.

### What is NOT falsified, and the distinction that matters

The two in-repo sentences #19275 quoted verbatim **remain true** — they are about the per-write **snapshot**, not about author-time rules: `runtime-gate.ts` and `validate-security-posture.ts:1089-1092` say the snapshot **neither carries nor maps** `positions` / `apps` (its context keys are objects / permissions / books / datasets). The card generalised 「the snapshot does not carry them」 into 「no author-time rule reads them」. Those are different claims and only the first is evidenced.

### Why this bears on the question you are being asked

This card offers two arms — **retire the declaration**, or **build the rules** — on the stated ground that arm (A) (bridge an existing author-time rule) 「不成立」. If a gating rule already reads both collections, **arm (A) is not excluded by the fact the card cites**, and the choice put to you is narrower than the evidence supports.

⛔ This seat states **no** preference among the arms and ⛔ takes no position on whether bridging `validateSecurityRoleWord` is *wise* — `CLI_ONLY` is a declared surface and the snapshot gap is real, so bridging may still be the wrong move for reasons this comment does not measure. ⛔ Nothing here is measured about whether the rule would **fire** on a real write: every reading above is source-level, no rule was executed. That is named as NOT MEASURED, not glossed.

⛔ This seat writes no label on this card, does not answer it, and does not re-file it. The `needs-user-decision` state stands and the card remains triage's and the director's.

### Adjacent, from the same round

The census's own population has moved since filing: `dataset` **left** (PR #19272 merged 10:13:03Z) and **`datasource` entered** — a 13th member the card never listed, invisible to single-line readers because its registry entry is multi-line (`metadata-plugin.zod.ts:929-947`), and present on the card's **own** ref. ⇒ this seat is filing that separately. Membership differs by two while the count reads 13 both times, which is exactly the shape a bare count hides.

— `domain:spec` seat 3

Ruling: batch #203 item 3 · letter B · maintainer 「203 同意」 2026-09-21T01:24Z

Director seat, summon #25 (`session_012GcsUbuqFGBibkEDMRC1eE`). Presented with this seat's recommendation B from facet ①; the maintainer approved the batch as presented. Governing text: `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` 〈优先级〉4 「声明了的…在运行时兑现」; ADR-0010 (`allowRuntimeCreate: true` = tenants may author brand-new items).

**Ruled: keep `app` / `position` runtime-creatable and make the rules real on every door.** The one existing gating rule that reads both collections (`validateSecurityRoleWord`, today `surfaces: CLI_ONLY`) becomes `CLI_AND_RUNTIME`, and the per-write snapshot (`runtime-gate.ts`) carries `apps` and `positions` so the rule can fire on a Studio / `/meta` / MCP write. A (retiring the declaration) is ⛔ not taken: it would close the Studio app designer's own path, a shipped tenant capability, and the answer the platform gives long-term is one rule set behind every door, not fewer doors.

**Execution:** `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this stroke; `domain:spec` seat dispatches, `priority:p1` unchanged. Dispatch names: the surface change on the rule entry, the snapshot widening for the two collections (with the `validate-security-posture.runtime-surface.test.ts` pin inverted deliberately — it pinned CLI-only for the reason this ruling removes), one test per collection proving a runtime write with a bad role word is refused, and a lit control that a good write passes. Same policy as #19275's group A; the two land as separate PRs but the spec seat may run them serially in one dev round. Not measured and still owed in the report: whether the rule FIRES on a real write (source-level readings only so far).

## 前提过时检查 —— 三面,逐面量在 `origin/main` `fbc12be3`

**工作项面(核心,⛔ 不对卡核验)。** 裁决点名的两处缺口在树上逐字为真:

- `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts:1595-1608` —— `validateSecurityRoleWord` 条目 `surfaces: CLI_ONLY`,`surfaceReason` 自述 「the per-write snapshot neither carries nor maps positions/apps … **It crosses whole — positions/apps carried, mapped and declared — or stays behind; it stays behind until that wiring exists**」。
- `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.ts:140` —— 「nothing on the runtime surface reads `positions` / `apps` — so those are **NOT carried**. Widening the snapshot is a one-key edit here plus a `CONTEXT_STACK_KEYS` entry, **made when a rule that reads the collection actually crosses the wall**」。

⇒ 树自己把「何时该做这笔」写成了条件句,而本裁决正是那个条件。⭐ 并且 `[#13977]` 记着一道现成的安全网:往那个 shape 加一个键,**编译器会要求**配套的 `CONTEXT_STACK_KEYS` 行,否则本包停止构建 —— 半边编辑在这里是**编译期**可捕获的,⛔ 不靠人记得。

**动作面.** `git log origin/main -- authoring-rules.ts runtime-gate.ts validate-security-posture.ts` 最新一笔 `58644ad5`(#19272,dataset publish door)。⛔ 没有任何一笔已经做掉本裁决点名的动作。

**卡引用面(现读,⛔ 不引裁决写作时的描述).** #19275 —— 裁决同批 item 4,现状 `pm:queue`,`needs-user-decision` 已摘。#7220(split 判据的出处)与 #8310(上一次 flip)在文内被引作理由,本轮 ⛔ 不动它们。

## 串行面,2026-09-21T01:58:18Z,17 张 open PR 全量(每张文件清单读到短页)

八个目标文件 **无一被任何 open PR 持有**。⚠️ 同包**不**同文件的 **PR #19472** 确实在 `packages/lint/src/` 里(`object-graph*`、`validate-field-consumers*`、`validate-object-references*`)—— 按 「同批独立性按**文件面不相交**判,⛔ 不按包」,文件面不交 ⇒ **不串行**;记在这里是因为「同包」是最容易被误读成冲突的那种邻近。亮控:8 张 open PR 持有 `packages/*/src/**`(#19314 #19335 #19342 #19373 #19374 #19471 #19472 #19473)⇒ 上面的「自由」不是坏扫描的假零。`packages/lint/CHANGELOG.md` 与 `package.json` 由 #17076(发版 PR,692 文件 / 7 页)持有 ⇒ ⛔ dev 两者皆不手改,changeset 走新文件。

## ⚠️ 本轮有一处**被裁决授权**的例外,派发令里点名写清

`validate-security-posture.runtime-surface.test.ts` 有**两条故意的钉子**会被本轮推翻 —— `:247`「position / app still reach no rule」与 `:262`「`security-role-word` stays behind WHOLE」(断言在 `:271`/`:279`/`:298`)。裁决原文:「with the `validate-security-posture.runtime-surface.test.ts` pin **inverted deliberately** — it pinned CLI-only for the reason this ruling removes」。⇒ 这是「⛔ 不得削弱既有断言」的**唯一豁免**,且只对这两条;任何**其它**断言要改仍然是停轮上报的信号。

⚠️ 行 **C6**:`domain:spec` 每一个交付轮都欠达档契约复审,`Clause-②: yes` **或 `no`** 皆然,记录不存在则 PR 不可落地。本席低于 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`,⛔ 不自审。

## 裁决自己声明的未测项,原样带进验收

「Not measured and still owed in the report: whether the rule **FIRES on a real write** (source-level readings only so far).」⇒ 本轮验收的核心不是「surfaces 字段变了」,而是**一次真实运行期写入被拒**,外加一条良性写入通过的亮控。
